messages:
marta: heads up — big LCP spike on /dashboard (EU canary) after yesterday's telemetry proxy push. heatmap + sparklines are ~400ms slower in the trace https://replay.internal/xyz :frowning:
kevin: saw that too. flame shows huge main-thread time from parse + a KV cache miss storm around the same timezone. bundle size climbed ~80KB on the metrics pane chunk
sam: reproduced locally — the new "viz-serializer" chunk is being parsed eagerly. who added that dependency? it's ~120KB minified and executing on nav
olivia: that was me, added a synchronous serializer for csv/export to keep export fast. didn't think about prefetch interaction — it's imported at top of metrics pane so hover triggers execution
marta: the telemetry shows kvcache miss spikes during nav; I suspect key schema changed (we added metric id namespace) so prefix lookup misses and we end up rehydrating big payloads
kevin: two problems: 1) prefetch policy is aggressive (we prefetch top-level chunks on nav) so parse happens earlier; 2) prefetch requests are counted against route quotas and backend throttles are kicking in, causing slower fetch -> parse window collision
sam: immediate mitigation: make viz-serializer lazy and only prefetch conditionally. quick pseudo: ```
if (chartsVisible > 2 && !isLowEndDevice()) {
  prefetch('/chunks/viz-serializer.js')
}
```
kevin: also mark the prefetch X-Purpose: prefetch (server can exclude those from quota calc) — otherwise infra sees a burst from background navs and applies backpressure
olivia: fine, I'll change to dynamic import() and add a smaller build for just CSV streaming. will also add chunkName to keep it split: `import(/* webpackChunkName: "viz-serializer" */ './serializer')`
marta: can we rollback the telemetry proxy canary while we fix this? traffic routing and prefix parsing seem coupled. @deploy-bot can you roll back canary-proxy to previous sha?
deploy-bot: deploy request received from marta — initiating rollback of canary-proxy to sha abc123. estimated completion ~3m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: opening PR with conditional prefetch + header to avoid quota counting. will include telemetry event hook so we can measure prefetch hits/misses (`prefetch.requested`, `prefetch.blocked`)
kevin: please also log kvcache.lookup.variant in the event so we know if schema mismatch is the root cause. I'll review the PR once up
olivia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/viz/pull/432 — added dynamic import, chunkName, and prefetch header. kept fallback to dynamic import without prefetch on low-end devices and mobile
marta: after rollback LCP dropped ~400ms on the canary samples — still watching. great quick turnaround everyone. let's run a small canary with Olivia's changes before re-promoting. :party-parrot:
kevin: agreed — add telemetry gating for 48h and a canary rollout at 10% EU only. also add an alert if median LCP > baseline +200ms
sam: noted. I'll add the alert rule and the canary manifest change in the PR
olivia: thanks — will also produce a trimmed serializer build and measure parse time in CI
marta: awesome. follow-ups: 1) telemetry key migration doc (sam), 2) prefetch quota exclusion on infra side (kevin), 3) small-serializer release (olivia). I'll file tickets after this thread
kevin: nits in the PR but overall LGTM once the header is wired. thanks
deploy-bot: rollback complete for canary-proxy -> sha abc123. monitoring.
